{{Quote|I remember that Twi'lek. Used to be a scummy slaver. Had a bad rep, a real ruthless creep.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], about Gele'ren|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
'''Gele'ren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] and [[Crime lord/Legends|underboss]] in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'd suggest looking up Gele'ren, a Twi'lek who works for the Cartel. Word is he hates the Eidolon more than just about anybody.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Gele'ren was in conflict with the former [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]] since the latter created a successful security company, [[Eidolon Security]], taking over many clients of the Hutt Cartel.<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Gele'ren and his slicer [[Anuli]] assisted the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] in tracking down the Eidolon, the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] target on the moon.<ref name="TOR:TEoME" /><ref name="TOR:EB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Economic Boom|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

When Anuli sliced and uploaded Eidolon Security's records, the Eidolon retaliated by sending his [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] to ambush Gele'ren's base. Gele'ren and Anuli were killed in the onslaught. While contacting Hunter, the Eidolon mentioned mounting Gele'ren's severed head on his wall.<ref name="TOR:IE" />
